style: Premium dark SaaS. Deep navy/indigo field with a faint constellation network and hairline grid (from the ProAxis site). Bold geometric display type, indigo-to-purple gradient emphasis, one orange CTA accent. Confident, fast, clean; the double-chevron mark is the single recurring motif (logo pieces, chevron wipe bands, list bullets).
font: Montserrat (400/700/900) for display, JetBrains Mono (400/700) for kickers/labels; both HF-bundled

local_assets.treatment: browser frame + perspective tilt + slow push

brief: A 15s brand promo for ProAxis, the white-label agency platform. The double-chevron mark slides in piece by piece over a drawing constellation, blooms, and the wordmark wipes out from behind it. A chevron band sweeps the frame into the site headline 'Run your entire creative studio from one platform'. Six features then punch through a left-anchored kinetic slot (mask-rise names, mono index, progress rule) while a workspace panel on the right ticks each one off, so all six stay readable. A tilted real dashboard flash sells the multi-tenant, white-label reality, then a second chevron sweep lands the closing line 'Launch your agency in days, not months.' over the ProAxis lockup with an orange 'Start free at proaxis.ai' CTA pill, holding still to the end. Dominant motion idea: the chevron 'push' to the right.
block: logo-outro (adapted inline: piece-by-piece assembly, expand/close, glow bloom, tagline + URL pill) + caption-kinetic-slam language (hand-authored slot, no caption block fits a feature list)
